limits: Only saved model references with available exact public files or installed KiCad model stems are remapped.
Missing CERN, vendor and local files are explicitly listed, without replacement geometry.
STEP meshing is a browser display derivative; the pinned upstream STEP and PCB sources remain authoritative.

legacyIdentityNormalization.rule: Rename only a top-level footprint tstamp field to uuid, preserving its exact saved identity value. Do not add a duplicate identifier. Existing UUIDs, nested pad identities, saved model transforms and electrical/physical geometry remain unchanged.
legacyIdentityNormalization.reconstructionCheck: Reversing only the recorded identity-keyword normalization reproduces the model-path-adapted PCB byte for byte.

legacyIdentityNormalization.reconstructionCheck: Reversing only the recorded identity-keyword normalization reproduces the model-path-adapted PCB byte for byte.

availabilityEvidence.finding: CERN public component library explicitly excludes 3D models and vendor datasheets because many are third-party intellectual property. No exact public source was established for Marble missing custom references.

geometryOptimization.scope: Each individual component GLB only; no cross-component/whole-board merge. Existing model-local millimetre/Z-up coordinates retained by baking the verified source scene transform into vertex data. Meshes merge only when every compared material property and vertex attribute schema is identical.
geometryOptimization.tools: Existing Three.js0.171.0 BufferGeometryUtils.mergeGeometries and GLTFExporter/GLTFLoader, no dependency installation.
geometryOptimization.verification: All36 optimized GLBs reloaded with the pinned actualGLTFLoader. Ordered world-space triangle vertices (including triangle order/winding), normalized world normals, every present vertex attribute, material properties, and scene bounds agree within recorded float32 tolerances. No texture, reflected-transform, skinning, morph-target or partial-draw cases were accepted.
geometryOptimization.unchanged: One original WRL retained at218meshes; PCB source bytes and derived-board hashes unchanged by optimization.
